title: limonium incanum
intro: Limonium incanum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region, characterized by its small purple flowers and silvery-gray leaves. The health benefits of Limonium incanum include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues and skin irritations, while also exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Limonium incanum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
